basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, who recently got into Reddit and anime. I spend my evenings watching anime and exploring new hobbies such as rifle shooting and gaming. I'm not a fan of complicated site interfaces and prefer platforms that are straightforward and easy to navigate. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. Currently single and focusing on personal growth and new interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas. My knowledge comes primarily from my work as a software developer and my passion for self-learning through online courses and tutorials. Recently, I've been diving into anime culture, learning through shows and community discussions.
